phase: A: direct port infrastructure, not a playable game

hardware.disk_timing: 1989_3500rpm generic proxy; NOT final Wren V

platform.verification: User reported success; assistant independently read C:/PLATFORM.TXT and observed the DOS result screen.

display.verification: Assistant read C:/DISPLAY.TXT and observed automatic return to DOS text mode.
display.visual_check: Held pattern observed: full 4:3 image, four borders including distinct last row, expected diagonal palette pattern; no obvious plane-interleaving or cropping.
display.keyboard_exit: Physical Escape completed the held probe; assistant independently read its C:/DISPLAY.TXT with RESULT=PASS. Automated key injection remains unverified.

page_flipping.verification: Read C:/DISPLAY.TXT from isolated guest disk; verifies three presentation pages, CRTC start registers and complete plane readback.

game_facing_adapters.verification: Read C:/ADAPTER.TXT from isolated guest disk. Pattern uses original pinned fonts/drawing bodies. Keyboard hardware and interactive gameplay are not tested by this probe; visual font diagnostic inspection remains pending.

startup_interrupts.verification: Read C:/SYSTEM.TXT and observed DOS interrupts: PASS / return to DOS. Automatic controller D2 injection exercises controller/PIC/IRQ1/translation, not Windows input automation or human gameplay. Profiler frame decoding is specific to the pinned normal CWSDPMI r7 binary. Game simulation remains the unchanged 20 Hz accumulator. Audio hook exists but no audio adapter is bound.

mouse_transport.verification: Assistant read C:/MOUSE.TXT and observed return to DOS with PASS. UART loopback packets exercise real driver IRQ4 delivery with Mode X and the custom PIT active. Includes one-count deltas, signed packet extrema, all left/right masks, multi-packet +381/-384 totals and linear response after reset. Does not verify Windows capture or physical mouse ingress. CuteMouse 2.1 beta 4 was rejected after measured (127,127) packets returned (381,381); inspected 1.9.1 source and guest evidence confirm /R11 linear counters.

temporary_terrain_transport.verification: Read C:/STORAGE.TXT from the private HDD, independently compared the entire TERRAIN.TMP with exact expected slot changes and confirmed all other bytes unchanged. Real DOS FAT16 I/O and strict INT21/AX6800 carry-checked commit/reopen ran with resident game timer/key IRQs installed. Diagnostic duration is not a traversal/FPS benchmark. Temporary columns and world ownership are not yet integrated; this is not durable save/load evidence. Finished emulator process was stopped after its exact executable/VM identity was checked.

persistent_save_transport_codec.verification: Read C:/SAVEIO.TXT, compared the entire WORLD.SAV against the independent Python byte oracle, including exact bank headers/checksums/generations, payload/padding and untouched trailing tracks. Transport and retained codec ran with resident game timer/key IRQs on the primary guest. World/mob providers are mocks; no full world/cache/mob save/load, restart, gameplay, power-loss durability or FPS claim. Completed emulator process was stopped after exact executable/private VM identity checks.

limitations: Diagnostics only: no gameplay, renderer FPS, audio, physical mouse/keyboard ingress, full world/save/cache integration or full parity validation.
Single diagnostic runs, not repeatable performance benchmarks or a Mode X vs Mode 13h comparison.
VGA_TICKS times 16 Mode 13h uploads, not Mode X packing, whole frames or game FPS.
Inherited firmware and motherboard proxies remain unauthenticated as exact 1989 retail hardware.
Runtime images and ROMs are intentionally not tracked; only small result summaries and source are committed.
